text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Did you celebrate with any traditional cuisine? I tried making a full box of osechi dishes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have plenty to share, if you'd like me to bring you any.
choice_data_list: It must've taken a lot of work to make everything yourself.
It must've taken a lot of work to make everything yourself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It was a challenge, yes. But I wanted to immerse myself entirely in the local New Year's customs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Besides, this will be a year of challenges. An early start will only help me in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I will be facing my venerated seniors. Every type of preparation is invaluable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So yes—on that note…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The year's tone is set on day one, as they say. Why don't we talk about our aspirations for the upcoming year?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What would you like to accomplish this year, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Racing knowledge… I see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Races like the Classics demand more than just brute strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please enlighten me with your tactical insight.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to start right away?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder looks so motivated that I end up spending the whole of New Year's Day poring over race films with her—and snacking our way through her handmade dishes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A wise choice—I wouldn't want to miss any races due to poor conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course, I will do my best to attend to my own health as well… but Trainer, how about yours?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I hope you aren't using New Year's as an excuse to stay up late and overeat, are you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend the rest of the day in a deep discussion over healthy lifestyle practices.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm… My skills, you say?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I've been wanting to work on shortening my stride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a little more practice, Grass Wonder's stride could become the best weapon in her arsenal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While small fast steps aren't sustainable in longer races, they would give quick acceleration for a last spurt.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Master oneself." I will fight back my instincts and develop a controlled path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's competitive spirit is in full force, so we decide to get a jump start on training.
